milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch_button produces the item directly in the player's inventory. The player must first convert birch logs to birch planks (1 log → 4 planks), then craft 1 birch plank into 1 birch_button using the crafting table. This is the most reliable check for a crafting task — the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not present in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch_trapdoor produces the item directly in the player's inventory. The player must arrange 6 birch planks in a 2x3 pattern in the crafting table's 3x3 grid, which yields 2 birch_trapdoors. Checking for min_count=1 is sufficient and robust since the recipe always produces at least 2. The item is not in the starting inventory, so any presence confirms successful crafting.
